scenes.headline: How a transformer lets tokens skip whole blocks
scenes.sub: Mixture-of-Depths: one router, top-k per block
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Obsidian! Not every token needs every layer. Here's how a router picks the ones that do.

scenes.text: Each routed block processes only its top 12.5% of tokens; the rest ride the residual stream past it, untouched.
scenes.say: Each routed block processes only its top eighth of tokens. The rest ride the residual stream past it.

steps.say: A router gives each token one number: how much this block wants it.

steps.note: 256 of 2,048 tokens, attending only to each other
steps.say: Only the top two hundred fifty-six of two thousand and forty-eight get the block.
Their output is scaled by that number, which trains the router, and added to the stream.

steps.note: the other 1,792 skip at no cost
steps.say: Everyone else skips, carried past on the residual stream for free.

scenes.title: Every routed block picks its own tokens

steps.label: Each routed block keeps 2 of 16
steps.note: 12.5% capacity, a different subset in every block
steps.say: Each routed block keeps its own eighth, so a token can skip a middle block and come back later.

scenes.title: What a routed block saves
scenes.say: Two kinds of work shrink differently.

parts.say: Projections and the MLP scale with the tokens kept: an eighth.

parts.note: attention scores: 1/64, fewer queries and fewer keys
parts.say: Attention scores shrink twice over, fewer queries and fewer keys: a sixty-fourth.

scenes.title: Sampling without seeing the future
scenes.say: Top-k needs the whole sequence. Sampling only sees the past.

items.say: So a small predictor learns to guess the cut.
At sampling time it decides alone, right ninety-seven to ninety-nine percent of the time.

scenes.label: faster to step, at the same loss as the baseline
scenes.say: A small Mixture-of-Depths model matched the baseline's loss and stepped sixty-six percent faster.

left.title: Mixture-of-Experts
items: Many MLPs; each token picks a few
left.say: Mixture-of-experts picks among many MLPs, so compute per token stays flat.

right.title: Mixture-of-Depths
right.say: Mixture-of-depths picks one block or nothing, so compute falls, attention included.

scenes.text: Fix the budget before training; let the router decide, block by block, which tokens spend it.
scenes.say: Fix the budget in advance, and the router decides, block by block, which tokens spend it.

recap: Router scores tokens; the top k get the block
A small predictor makes sampling causal
scenes.say: A router, a top-k, a residual skip, and a predictor so sampling never peeks ahead.
